snippet.title: Umamusume: Pretty Derby – Official Trailer | Faster than Anyone
snippet.description:
Umamusume: Pretty Derby is racing towards its English debut!

The English release of the game will launch on June 26, 2025.

Faster than Anyone is a glimpse of what's to come in the dramatic world of Umamusume racing, set to the song "Girls' Legend U".

Pre-register now!
https://umamusume.com/

Official X (Twitter) Account
https://twitter.com/umamusume_eng

Official Facebook Page
https://www.facebook.com/umamusume.eng

#Umamusume #Cygames
